title: Phenol-chloroform extraction for museum hides using Phase lock gel
author: Karla Vargas
materials: lysis buffer (50 mM Tris pH 8.0, 50 mM EDTA, 25 mM sucrose, 100 mM NaCl)

steps.title: Prepare specimen samples
steps.instruction: Cut small pieces of the specimen (1 to 3 mm) and place them in labeled 2.0 mL tubes.

steps.title: Wash samples with ethanol
steps.instruction: Perform a series of ethanol washes to remove salts from the samples.

substeps.instruction: Add 600 μL of 95% ethanol to each tube.
Gently flick the tube to ensure the sample is fully immersed.
Allow the sample to soak for 2–3 hours.
Pipette off the ethanol and add another 600 μL of fresh ethanol; repeat this process 2–3 times during the day.
At the end of the day, add fresh ethanol and leave samples soaking overnight at room temperature.

steps.title: Dry the samples
steps.instruction: Remove the sample from the ethanol soak and remove excess liquid.

substeps.instruction: Pat off excess ethanol using a clean Kimwipe, or for very small samples, place in an incubator at 42°C for 30–60 minutes to dry.

steps.title: Prepare for homogenization
steps.instruction: Transfer the dried sample into a clean 2.0 mL screw-cap tube and add one Next Advance 3.5 mm UFO Stainless Bead per tube.

steps.title: Homogenize samples
steps.instruction: Use a BeadBug ‱ Microtube Homogenizer (Benchmark Scientific, Inc.) to process the samples.

substeps.instruction: Place the device on a clean, flat, stable surface.
Insert the 2.0 mL screw-cap tubes fully into the tube holder.
Select the desired speed and time (maximum: 4000 rpm, 3 min).
Close the lid and press 'Start/Stop' to begin the cycle.

steps.title: Lysis and Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: Add lysis reagents and incubate the samples.

substeps.instruction: Add ~500 μL of lysis buffer (50 mM Tris pH 8.0, 50 mM EDTA, 25 mM sucrose, 100 mM NaCl, 1.0% SDS, 40 mM DTT).
Add 25 μL of 20 mg/mL Proteinase K to the tube.
Incubate the sample at 55°C for 24–48 hours with agitation or rotation, if possible.

steps.title: Prepare phase lock gel tubes
steps.instruction: Spin the phase lock gel tubes (2 per sample) at maximum speed for 5 minutes.

steps.title: First phenol-chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Perform the first round of extraction using a phase lock 'heavy' gel tube.

substeps.instruction: Pipette ~500 μL of lysate into a 2.0 mL phase lock 'heavy' gel tube containing 500 μL of a phenol:chloroform (1:1) mixture.
Add ~200 μL of PCR-grade water (do not exceed tube capacity).
Mix by rocking gently for 5 minutes until the mixture appears milky.
Centrifuge at maximum speed for 5 minutes to separate the phases.

steps.title: Second phenol-chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Perform a second round of extraction to further purify the aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase into a new phase lock 'heavy' gel tube containing 500 μL of the phenol:chloroform (1:1) mixture.
Add ~200 μL of PCR-grade water.
Mix by rocking gently for 5 minutes until the mixture appears milky.
Centrifuge at maximum speed for 5 minutes to separate the phases.

steps.title: DNA precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the DNA from the final aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase into a new 1.75 mL snap-cap tube (conical bottom).
Add 1/10 volume of 3M NaOAc and mix gently by rocking.
Add 0.6 volume of cold isopropanol and invert the tube several times; add more isopropanol if necessary.
Incubate the tube on ice overnight at 4°C (optional, to increase yield).
Pellet the DNA by centrifugation at maximum speed for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Wash and dry DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Clean the DNA pellet with ethanol washes and dry it.

substeps.instruction: Carefully decant the liquid and rinse the pellet with 1 mL of 70% ethanol (cold if possible), mixing gently by rocking.
Pellet the DNA by centrifugation at maximum speed for 5 minutes.
Carefully decant the ethanol and rinse the pellet with 1 mL of 95% ethanol (cold if possible), mixing gently by rocking.
Pellet the DNA by centrifugation at maximum speed for 5 minutes.
Carefully decant the ethanol and dry the DNA pellet in a vacuum chamber (no heat) overnight.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried DNA pellet in preheated buffer.

substeps.instruction: Preheat Low TE buffer (pH 8.0) to 55°C.
Resuspend the pellet using 50 μL for small pellets, 100 μL for medium pellets, or 200 μL for large pellets.

steps.title: Prepare Phenol:Chloroform Mixture
steps.instruction: Prepare the extraction mixture using one of the following methods.

substeps.instruction: Mix equal parts of saturated phenol and chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1), OR
Use phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1).
